extracted.intended_audience: authors and teams preparing Cochrane systematic reviews of interventions; systematic reviewers; evidence synthesis researchers
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for planning, conducting, analysing, reporting, and updating systematic reviews of interventions following the Cochrane Handbook (version 6.5, 2024). Covers methods from question formulation through synthesis, GRADE, and specialised topics (equity, economics, qualitative evidence, non-randomized studies, IPD, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter I: Introduction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table of contents entry only on this page; full introductory guidance is in the handbook chapter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Planning a Cochrane Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter II: Planning a Cochrane Review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; see chapter for detailed planning criteria and processes (protocols, team roles, timelines).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting the review
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter III: Reporting the review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; chapter contains standards for how to report methods and results of a Cochrane review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Figures: considerations and recommendations
rubrics_metrics.description: III.S1 Supplementary material: Considerations and recommendations for figures in Cochrane reviews: graphs of statistical data
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supplement TOC entry only; full guidance on presentation of statistical figures is in the supplement chapter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plain language summary guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: III.S2 Supplementary material: Guidance for writing a Cochrane Plain language summary
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supplement TOC entry only; provides guidance for writing accessible plain-language summaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updating a review
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter IV: Updating the review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; includes criteria and procedures for when and how to update a review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overviews of reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter V: Overviews of Reviews
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; guidance on preparing overviews (reviews of reviews) is in the chapter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Starting a review
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 1: Starting a review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; chapter addresses initial steps and decisions when beginning a Cochrane review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Determining scope and questions
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 2: Determining the scope of the review and the questions it will address
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; chapter sets out criteria for formulating review questions and scope (PICO and related considerations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Defining inclusion criteria and grouping for synthesis
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 3: Defining the criteria for including studies and how they will be grouped for the synthesis
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; chapter provides standards for eligibility criteria and strategies for grouping studies for synthesis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Searching for and selecting studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 4: Searching for and selecting studies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; chapter covers search strategies, databases, grey literature, screening and selection procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Searching technical supplement
rubrics_metrics.description: 4.S1 Supplementary material: Technical supplement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; supplementary technical material related to searching and selection is available in this supplement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Searching resources appendix
rubrics_metrics.description: 4.S2 Supplementary material: Appendix of resources
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; appendix lists resources relevant to searching and study identification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collecting data
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 5: Collecting data
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; chapter details data extraction, management, double data entry, and handling of missing or unclear data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choosing effect measures & computing estimates
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 6: Choosing effect measures and computing estimates of effect
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; chapter covers selection of effect measures (RR, OR, mean differences), transformations, and calculation of estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Considering bias and conflicts of interest among included studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 7: Considering bias and conflicts of interest among the included studies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; chapter explains how to identify and consider study-level biases and conflicts when synthesising evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assessing risk of bias in randomized trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 8: Assessing risk of bias in a randomized trial
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; chapter describes tools and domains for assessing risk of bias in RCTs (e.g., RoB tool guidance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Summarizing study characteristics and preparing for synthesis
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 9: Summarizing study characteristics and preparing for synthesis
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; includes guidance on study tables, descriptive summaries, and preparing data for meta-analysis or other synthesis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analysing data and undertaking meta-analyses
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 10: Analysing data and undertaking meta-analyses
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; chapter covers statistical synthesis methods, models (fixed/random), heterogeneity, subgroup and sensitivity analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Undertaking network meta-analyses
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 11: Undertaking network meta-analyses
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; guidance on methods and assumptions for network (multiple treatment) meta-analysis is in the chapter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Synthesizing and presenting findings using other methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 12: Synthesizing and presenting findings using other methods
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; addresses non-meta-analytic synthesis approaches (e.g., narrative, qualitative synthesis) and presentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assessing bias due to missing results in a synthesis
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 13: Assessing risk of bias due to missing results in a synthesis
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; chapter discusses publication bias, selective reporting, and methods to assess missing-results bias.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summary of findings tables & grading certainty (GRADE)
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 14: Completing ‘Summary of findings’ tables and grading the certainty of the evidence
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; chapter gives criteria for constructing SoF tables and applying GRADE to rate certainty of evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interpreting results and drawing conclusions
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 15: Interpreting results and drawing conclusions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; chapter provides guidance on interpretation, implications for practice and research, and drawing justified conclusions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equity and specific populations
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 16: Equity and specific populations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; chapter addresses consideration of equity, subgroup applicability, and population-specific issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intervention complexity
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 17: Intervention complexity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; guidance on handling complex interventions and implications for synthesis and interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patient-reported outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 18: Patient-reported outcomes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; chapter covers selection, measurement, and synthesis of patient-reported outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adverse effects
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 19: Adverse effects
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; guidance on identifying, collecting, analysing and reporting harms/adverse events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economic evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 20: Economic evidence
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; chapter addresses inclusion and synthesis of economic evaluations alongside effectiveness evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economic evidence technical supplement
rubrics_metrics.description: 20.S Technical Supplement: Integrated full systematic review of economic evidence
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; supplementary technical material on economic evidence methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Qualitative evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 21: Qualitative evidence
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; guidance on including and synthesising qualitative research in reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prospective approaches to accumulating evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 22: Prospective approaches to accumulating evidence
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; chapter discusses prospective methods such as living systematic reviews and trial sequential approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Including variants on randomized trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 23: Including variants on randomized trials
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; guidance on handling cluster, crossover, and other randomized-trial variants in reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Including non-randomized studies on intervention effects
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 24: Including non-randomized studies on intervention effects
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; chapter sets out approaches for inclusion, appraisal, and synthesis of non-randomized evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assessing risk of bias in non-randomized studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 25: Assessing risk of bias in a non-randomized study
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; chapter describes tools and domains for assessing bias in non-randomized studies (e.g., ROBINS-I guidance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Individual participant data
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 26: Individual participant data
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; guidance on collecting, analysing and synthesising individual participant data (IPD) meta-analyses.
